response.explanation: The domain class Subscription (src/domain/subscription.ts) imports the concrete outbound adapter SystemClock from src/adapters/outbound/system-clock.ts (line 1). It creates its own instance as a private field (line 4) and calls clock.now() in isActive() (line 9). The graph confirms this: Subscription has a FLOWS_TO edge and a CALLS edge to SystemClock. FF-P06 flags this because a domain class holds an infrastructure type. The core depends directly on an adapter instead of a port it owns, so the dependency points outward. As a result, the domain cannot be tested with a controlled time source and is coupled to the adapter layer. However, the project has decided to allow exactly this. ADR-0002 is Accepted and says the domain core may import SystemClock from that exact path directly, and that no Clock port will be added for now. So the code matches what the project declared it wants. The rule's verdict still stands.
